description: capture_timestamp must be a real ISO 8601 calendar date/time, not just a string matching the pattern.
expected_reason: February 30th does not exist; a naive Date.parse silently rolls this over to March 2nd instead of rejecting it, so a conforming validator must check the calendar explicitly. The schema's own "pattern" regex only checks digit shape, and this package deliberately leaves ajv's "date-time" format keyword unvalidated (see tests/json-schema.test.ts) since format keywords are advisory, not structural, in JSON Schema.
